issue (cited in the notes as #4): Controllers should support parallel processing of resources [closed; labels performance, roadmap]
All controllers should support the processing of their resources in parallel, i.e. a long operation to create a cloud provider resource should not block the creation of other instances of that same type of resource.

We also need to consider the allowed parallelism for managing a single resource instance. For example, if a long operation is running in a controller for a specific resource instance, and the CRD for that instance is updated, should the controller pro…

until the first update is done? All controllers should have a level triggered (as opposed to edge triggered) design, but how should new resource events be handled when an existing event is already being processed?

This is also very related to locking, resiliency and idempotence.
